contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTANTI-NVS MAX AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine I (AD 306-37), dating to AD 332-3 (Reece Period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTI-NVS MAX AVG. Obverse shows a laureate, draped and cuirassed bust right. Mint of Trier, - // TR•(P). RIC VII, p. 216, no. 538. Die axis is 6 o'clock.
